qs.title: QS World University Rankings 2027 (18 June 2026), Australian list as reported by Time Out

english_policy.waiver_notes: Met without a test if you completed six years of schooling at an English medium institution in an English-speaking country before age 19 and hold, for example, a VCE English, Literature or English Language study score of 25 (units 3 and 4) or an equivalent result in an equivalent English subject in a senior secondary qualification as listed in Monash's study credit and admissions eligibility search; or by tertiary study (e.g. half a year of full-time diploma-level or higher study in an English medium institution). Applicants without six years of English-medium schooling have separate secondary, tertiary and test routes listed on the page. Monash does not accept competency-based qualifications as evidence of English. Time limits on tests apply.

english.notes: IELTS Academic (also UKVI, One Skill Retake and Online). English Level A, which applies to the Computer Science, Economics and Engineering (Honours) courses.
Old 0-120 scale (the 79 total is on the 0-120 scale), English Level A.
Pearson Test of English Academic (also UKVI), English Level A; no communicative skills score below 50.

C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency, English Level A. The page also lists TOEFL Essentials 8 overall (reading 7, listening 7, writing 9, speaking 7) and LanguageCert Academic 67 (reading 60, listening 57, writing 64, speaking 70). Duolingo is not among the tests listed; other tests may be assessed at application.

tier_notes.general: QS World University Rankings 2027: world rank 31, 5th of the Australian universities in the table (S = ranks 1-5 on the national scale; a national scale, so not comparable with US tiers).
